title: d-uniform bounds for the difference-quotient system (Schauder data H4-H7 and the derivative of w_d)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, 0 < alpha <= 1, L := L(R^n, R^l), U an open subset of R^n, a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), Phi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L), v : R^n -> R^l, xb, e in R^n and R > 0 with closedBall(xb, 4R) ⊆ U and |e| <= 1. Assume: for all P, Q in L, x ↦ a(x)[P][Q] is C^1 on U and its first derivative (iteratedFDeriv R 1) is alpha-Hoelder on every compact subset of U; for all P, x ↦ Phi(x)[P] has the same property; and IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 alpha v U. Then there is M such that for every real d with d ≠ 0 and |d| < R, writing w_d(z) := d^{-1}(v(z + de) - v(z)), B := B_{2R}(xb) (open ball) and F_d(x, P) := d^{-1}(Phi(x + de)[P] - Phi(x)[P]) - d^{-1}(a(x + de)[Dv(x + de)][P] - a(x)[Dv(x + de)][P]): (i) |w_d(x)| <= M on B; (ii) w_d is C^1 on B; (iii) Dw_d(x) = d^{-1}(Dv(x + de) - Dv(x)) for x in B; (iv) Dw_d is alpha-Hoelder on B with some constant; (v) |F_d(x, P) - F_d(y, P)| <= M |x - y|^alpha ||P|| for all x, y in B and P in L.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (xb e : Rn n) (R : ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall xb (4 * R) ⊆ U → ‖e‖ ≤ 1 → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => a z P Q) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => a z P Q) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ x P) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => Φ z P) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => Φ z P) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 α v U → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 → |d| < R → (∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ‖d⁻¹ • (v (x + d • e) - v x)‖ ≤ M) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) (ball xb (2 * R)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x = d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e) - fderiv ℝ v x)) ∧ (∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ∀ y ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x - fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ∀ y ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |(d⁻¹ * (Φ (x + d • e) P - Φ x P) - d⁻¹ * (a (x + d • e) (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P - a x (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P)) - (d⁻¹ * (Φ (y + d • e) P - Φ y P) - d⁻¹ * (a (y + d • e) (fderiv ℝ v (y + d • e)) P - a y (fderiv ℝ v (y + d • e)) P))| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖
